newsitem.title: USA: Mark Centers board to cut dividend rate.
newsitem.headline: Mark Centers board to cut dividend rate.

text.p: Mark Centers Trust's board reduced the company's quarterly dividend to $0.20 a share, or an annual rate of $0.80, from $0.36, citing increased costs.

Tenant improvement and expansion costs associated with the recent leasing activity is more prudently funded with internally generated cash rather than increasing the company's debt levels, Mark Centers said.

Mark Centers said in a statement on Tuesday the $0.20 a share dividend is payable July 31, 1997, to shareholders of record on June 30, 1997 and will include a significant non-taxable return of capital component.
Also, Mark Centers currently has executed leases totaling 384,000 square feet bringing its portfolio to 89% leased as of May 31, 1997.
The majority of these leases will commence in fourth quarter of 1997 and the first quarter of 1998 and on an annualized basis generate $3.4 million in revenues, the company said.
